'''2012 European Championship Emil Wallin DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' Darth_Link
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
